zh.bio: 曾也鲁，中国农业大学土地科学与技术学院教授、博导，国家级高层次青年人才，达摩院青橙奖获得者。主要从事植被定量遥感、三维辐射传输建模、作物表型遥感、森林碳储量遥感估算等方向研究，融合无人机LiDAR、高光谱、卫星遥感与深度学习，发展植被结构与功能遥感反演方法。主持多项国家自然科学基金项目，成果发表于Remote Sensing of Environment等遥感领域一区Top期刊。

en.name: Yelu Zeng
en.title: Professor, PhD Supervisor
en.dept: College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University
en.bio: Yelu Zeng is a professor and PhD supervisor at the College of Land Science and Technology, China Agricultural University. His research focuses on quantitative vegetation remote sensing, 3D radiative transfer modeling, crop phenotyping, and forest carbon stock estimation. His group integrates UAV LiDAR, hyperspectral, satellite imagery and deep learning to develop new methods for retrieving vegetation structure and functions. He is the recipient of the Damo Academy Green Orange Award and leads multiple NSFC projects. Publications are mainly in top journals such as Remote Sensing of Environment.

join.zh: 课题组常年招收博士、硕士研究生，欢迎遥感、GIS、测绘、农业信息化、生态学背景同学报考。课题组主要开展无人机遥感、激光雷达、深度学习、植被辐射传输建模相关研究，有充足科研项目支撑。有意向请发送简历、成绩单、研究兴趣至邮箱 zengyelu@cau.edu.cn。
join.en: We recruit PhD and master students every year. Candidates with background in remote sensing, GIS, surveying, agri-informatics and ecology are welcome. Our research covers UAV remote sensing, LiDAR, deep learning and radiative transfer modeling. Please send CV, transcript and research statement to zengyelu@cau.edu.cn.
